settings.a: 15% off every subscription order, plus free delivery. The discount applies automatically at checkout.

settings.q: Can I skip, pause or cancel?
settings.a: Yes, anytime and with no fees. Manage everything from your account: skip a delivery, change the date, swap flavours or cancel.

settings.q: Can I mix products in one subscription?
settings.a: Yes. Add as many products as you like on subscription; they arrive together on your chosen schedule.
You pay for the first order today. After that you're charged just before each delivery, every 2 or 4 weeks, depending on what you choose.
